column1: Noncontrast axial CT normal variant CAVUMCSP01
column3:
Cavum septi pellucidi.
Reference: Vitalii Rogalskyi, Radiopaedia rID 48256, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. https://radiopaedia.org/cases/cavum-septum-pellucidum-cavum-vergae-and-cavum-veli-interpositi-annotated-ct
column4: Identify the normal midline CSF-space variant shown.
column9:
What it is: a CSF-like potential space between the leaflets of the septum pellucidum, anterior to the columns of the fornix, between the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles. It is a normal variant and is not part of the ventricular system.

Reference: Vitalii Rogalskyi, Radiopaedia rID 48256, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. https://radiopaedia.org/cases/cavum-septum-pellucidum-cavum-vergae-and-cavum-veli-interpositi-annotated-ct

column1: Noncontrast axial CT normal variant CAVUMVERGAE01
column3:
Cavum vergae.
Reference: Vitalii Rogalskyi, Radiopaedia rID 48256, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. https://radiopaedia.org/cases/cavum-septum-pellucidum-cavum-vergae-and-cavum-veli-interpositi-annotated-ct
column4: Identify the posterior midline CSF-space variant shown.
column9:
What it is: the posterior continuation of a cavum septi pellucidi, extending posterior to the columns of the fornix. It is a CSF-like normal variant rather than a true ventricle.

Reference: Vitalii Rogalskyi, Radiopaedia rID 48256, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. https://radiopaedia.org/cases/cavum-septum-pellucidum-cavum-vergae-and-cavum-veli-interpositi-annotated-ct

column1: Noncontrast axial CT normal variant CAVUMCVI01
column3:
Cavum veli interpositi.
Reference: Vitalii Rogalskyi, Radiopaedia rID 48256, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. https://radiopaedia.org/cases/cavum-septum-pellucidum-cavum-vergae-and-cavum-veli-interpositi-annotated-ct
column4: Identify the CSF-space variant near the roof of the third ventricle.
column9:
What it is: dilatation of the cistern of the velum interpositum, a triangular CSF space in the roof region of the third ventricle, below the fornices and above the internal cerebral veins/tela choroidea. When large, it can mimic a pineal-region cyst.

Reference: Vitalii Rogalskyi, Radiopaedia rID 48256, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. https://radiopaedia.org/cases/cavum-septum-pellucidum-cavum-vergae-and-cavum-veli-interpositi-annotated-ct
